trial_court: Senior Civil Judge, Proddatur, O.P. No.10 of 2007
case_name: Tanguturu Raja Sekhar Reddy vs Tanguturu Sasikala
facts_of_case: Husband sought annulment of marriage under Section 12(1)(c) r/w.12(2) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking annulment of marriage to prove that the marriage is null and void.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the burden lies on the party seeking annulment of marriage to prove that the marriage is null and void.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not annul a marriage unless it is proved that the marriage was null and void from the beginning.
legal_principles.held: This Court holds that the court will not annul a marriage unless it is proved that the marriage was null and void from the beginning.

outcome.final_order: No order as to costs; miscellaneous petitions pending consideration stand closed.

keywords: Latin maxim: justice must be done to all alike
use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for annulment of marriage
advising a client on the grounds for annulment
responding to an application for annulment
